profile.name: Thorlabs DC4100 多通道 LED 控制器
profile.description: 用于控制多通道 LED 照明的实验室光源控制器，可连接设备、切换各通道开关、设置和读取亮度，并查询序列号、固件和制造商信息。适用于显微成像或其他实验照明场景中的 LED 光源管理。
profile.description_en: A laboratory multi-channel LED illumination controller used to manage LED light sources. It supports connecting to the device, switching individual channels on or off, setting and reading brightness, and querying serial number, firmware, and manufacturer information. It is suitable for microscopy and other experimental illumination applications.
